Coverage_Description: Network dental benefits at designated clinics: scale & polish (once per policy year), oral exam/intra-oral X-ray, fillings, extraction, abscess and emergency treatment, plus 3-day; accidental death MOP100,000 and double accidental death up to MOP200,000 (inclusive of basic accidental death benefit)
customer requirement: Participating employer with an existing AIA group insurance scheme; employer and employee/dependant enrolment forms, required AML documents, and premium payment
price structure: Annual premium per insured member; annual payment mode
additional informations: 1-year benefit term; Macau-only; ages 65-69 are renewal only (protection up to 69)
